title: Fifth Avenue Is Again the World's Most Expensive Shopping Street

source.author: Renan Botelho de Carvalho
source.title: New York’s Fifth Avenue reclaims title as world’s most expensive retail street
source.note: Single source; the JLL availability figure and the earlier investment total are quoted by FashionUnited in the same article. Rolex '30-storey' rendered as '30 floors'.

figures.text: Upper Fifth Avenue again world's most expensive retail street, per Cushman & Wakefield report released Wednesday
figures.quote: New York's Upper Fifth Avenue is once again the world's most expensive retail street, according to Cushman & Wakefield's Main Streets Across the World 2026 report released on Wednesday.

figures.text: rents +35% over the past year to $2,700 per square foot a year
figures.quote: Rents on the corridor rose 35 percent over the past year to 2,700 dollars per square foot a year.

figures.text: third place in 2025 to first; first time at top since 2023
figures.quote: Fifth Avenue moved from third place in 2025 to first, its first time at the top since 2023.

figures.text: London's New Bond Street second at $2,230 per square foot
figures.quote: London's New Bond Street ranked second at 2,230 dollars per square foot

figures.text: Milan's Via Montenapoleone third at $2,160
figures.quote: followed by Milan's Via Montenapoleone at 2,160 dollars

figures.text: both streets flat over past year after large increases earlier
figures.quote: Rents on both streets were flat over the past year after large increases in previous years.

figures.text: last year's report: New Bond Street most expensive
figures.quote: In last year's report, New Bond Street was named the world's most expensive retail destination for the first time

figures.text: luxury groups invested nearly $4 billion in Fifth Avenue properties over two years (reported in February)
figures.quote: FashionUnited reported in February that luxury groups had invested nearly 4 billion dollars in Fifth Avenue properties over the previous two years.

figures.text: Kering paid almost $1 billion for a building
figures.quote: Kering paid almost 1 billion dollars for a building on the street

figures.text: Rolex building $250 million, 30-storey flagship
figures.quote: Rolex is building a 250 million dollar, 30-storey flagship

figures.text: Prada Group bought several buildings
figures.quote: Prada Group has bought several buildings

figures.text: New York City $400 million 'Future of Fifth' redesign
figures.quote: The street is also part of New York City's 400 million dollar "Future of Fifth" redesign.

figures.text: JLL: Manhattan top corridors retail availability 13.7% in Q4 2025, lowest since 2017
figures.quote: According to JLL, retail availability across Manhattan's top corridors fell to 13.7 percent in the fourth quarter of 2025, the lowest level since 2017.

figures.text: Dominic Brown: rents accelerate when strong demand meets limited availability; competition remains intense
figures.quote: demonstrates how quickly rents can accelerate when strong retailer demand meets limited availability

figures.text: report covers 147 retail locations
figures.quote: The report covers 147 retail locations worldwide.

figures.text: average rent +3% year-on-year in local currency, down from 4.3% growth in 2025
figures.quote: Rents rose an average of 3 percent year-on-year in local currency, down from 4.3 percent growth in 2025.

figures.text: 49% of streets rents rose, 19% declined, 32% stable
figures.quote: Almost half (49 percent) of the streets surveyed saw rents rise, 19 percent saw declines and 32 percent were stable.

figures.text: fashion: 50% of leasing deals, 57% of space across top 30 streets
figures.quote: It accounted for 50 percent of leasing deals and 57 percent of space taken across the top 30 streets

figures.text: international brands took about 90% of the space
figures.quote: International brands took about 90 percent of the space.

figures.text: Alanna Loeffler: competition for premier locations never more intense; flagship is brand-building platform driving engagement and loyalty
figures.quote: competition for premier locations has never been more intense ... it is a brand-building platform that drives visibility, customer engagement and long-term loyalty

figures.text: Miami Brickell Boulevard Corridor +43%, Mumbai Linking Road +28%
figures.quote: Miami's Brickell Boulevard Corridor saw rents rise 43 percent, Bucharest's Calea Victoriei 29 percent, Mumbai's Linking Road 28 percent

figures.text: London: Covent Garden and Regent Street each +13%
figures.quote: In London, rents on Covent Garden and Regent Street each rose 13 percent.

street.en: a public road in a city or town, with houses or shops

square.en: used with a unit to measure an area, like a square foot

foot.en: a unit for measuring length, a little less than one third of a meter

spare.en: not being used, so it is free for someone to use

space.en: an area that is empty or can be used

construct.en: to build something, like a building or a road

transformation.en: a big change in how something looks or works
transformation.vi: sự cải tạo, sự thay đổi lớn

availability.en: how much of something is free to use or buy
availability.vi: mức sẵn có (mặt bằng còn trống)

wide.en: covering many things or a large area

scope.en: the range of things that something deals with

behind.vi: đứng sau, là nguyên nhân của

phenomenon.en: something that happens and that people notice

interaction.en: when people talk or do things with each other

intensity.vi: mức độ gay gắt, cường độ

competition.en: a situation in which people or companies try to win against others

London.vi: Luân Đôn, thủ đô nước Anh

Via Montenapoleone.vi: phố mua sắm xa xỉ nổi tiếng nhất ở Milan

FashionUnited.vi: trang tin ngành thời trang (nguồn của bài này)

Rolex.vi: hãng đồng hồ xa xỉ của Thụy Sĩ

Future of Fifth.vi: "Tương lai của Đại lộ số 5" — dự án cải tạo con phố của thành phố

Manhattan.vi: quận trung tâm của thành phố New York

JLL.vi: công ty dịch vụ bất động sản của Mỹ

Dominic Brown.vi: trưởng bộ phận nghiên cứu quốc tế của Cushman & Wakefield

Alanna Loeffler.vi: giám đốc mảng bán lẻ khu vực châu Mỹ của Cushman & Wakefield

Brickell Boulevard.vi: đại lộ ở khu Brickell, Miami

Miami.vi: thành phố ở bang Florida, Mỹ

Mumbai.vi: thành phố lớn nhất Ấn Độ

Regent Street.vi: phố mua sắm lớn ở trung tâm Luân Đôn

Covent Garden.vi: khu mua sắm và giải trí ở trung tâm Luân Đôn
